description: Make an existing project a subproject of another, or take it back out with an empty parentKey. This is about ACCESS, not about names or issues: everyone who may reach the parent may reach the subproject too, in the role they hold there. Nothing is renamed, no issue moves, and the keys stay ordinary keys. Attaching needs an admin or somebody who leads BOTH projects, since neither can be volunteered by whoever leads the other; detaching needs a lead of either, since it only takes access away. One level: a subproject cannot have subprojects.

parentKey.description: Key of the project it becomes a subproject of, e.g. 'KYC'. Leave it out (or empty) to detach it and leave it a project of its own.

projectKey.description: Key of the project to move, e.g. 'KYCB2B'.

name: set_project_parent
